nodes.name: settings.local.json
nodes.summary: Local Claude Code settings file defining project-specific tool-permission rules that govern which commands and actions the coding agent may run automatically in this repository.

nodes.name: server-stopped
nodes.summary: Runtime state marker created by the superpowers brainstorming skill to record that its background server process has stopped.

nodes.name: server.pid
nodes.summary: Runtime PID file recorded by the superpowers brainstorming skill to track its background server process.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Ignore-pattern list for the Understand-Anything code-analysis plugin, excluding directories and files such as build output and dependencies from the project scan and knowledge-graph generation.

nodes.name: config.json
nodes.summary: Minimal configuration for the Understand-Anything plugin, setting the output language used when generating knowledge-graph summaries and documentation.

nodes.name: script.py.mako
nodes.summary: Mako template used by Alembic's `revision` command to scaffold new migration files with the standard `upgrade`/`downgrade` function stubs and revision metadata.
nodes.languageNotes: Mako is Alembic's default templating engine; `${...}` placeholders are substituted with the revision ID, down-revision, and message when `alembic revision` generates a new file.

nodes.name: 0001_initial.py
nodes.summary: Initial Alembic migration that enables the pgvector extension and creates the core `documents` and `chunks` tables, including the chunk embedding vector column.

nodes.name: 0002_fix_embedding_dim.py
nodes.summary: Follow-up migration that drops and recreates the `chunks` table to fix an incorrect pgvector embedding column dimension introduced by the initial migration.

nodes.name: 0003_add_fts_gin_index.py
nodes.summary: Migration adding a PostgreSQL GIN index for full-text search over chunk content, enabling the FTS side of the hybrid (vector + keyword) retrieval pipeline.

nodes.name: 0004_parent_child_chunks.py
nodes.summary: Migration introducing the parent-child chunk model: adds a parent-chunks table with constraints and indexes, and links existing chunks to their parent via a new foreign key column.

nodes.name: 0005_embedding_to_1536.py
nodes.summary: Migration resizing the chunk embedding column to 1536 dimensions to match the truncated qwen3-embedding-8b output routed through OpenRouter.

nodes.name: 0006_document_metadata.py
nodes.summary: Migration adding metadata columns (type, page/chunk counts, JSONB metadata, status fields) to the `documents` table along with a supporting index.

nodes.name: 0007_create_users.py
nodes.summary: Migration creating the `users` table (UUID id, username, password hash, active flag, created-at timestamp) with a unique index, establishing the schema for JWT-based authentication.

nodes.name: 0008_create_conversations_messages.py
nodes.summary: Migration creating `conversations` and `messages` tables with foreign keys to users and conversations, JSONB message metadata, and indexes — the schema backbone for persisted chat history.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker file that makes `backend/app` importable as the root Python package for the FastAPI backend.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker file that makes `backend/app/services` importable as a Python package for the backend's service layer, including the RAG pipeline.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker file that makes `backend/app/workers` importable as a Python package for Celery background worker code.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker file that makes `backend/evals` importable as a Python package for the RAG evaluation harness.

nodes.name: golden_set.yaml
nodes.summary: Golden evaluation dataset (question/expected-answer pairs) consumed by the `evals.run_eval` harness to score and compare RAG retrieval and generation quality across runs.

nodes.name: .gitkeep
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder file that keeps the otherwise-empty `backend/evals/results/` output directory tracked in git.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker file that makes `backend/scripts` importable as a Python package for backend maintenance and bootstrap scripts.

nodes.name: users
nodes.summary: Raw SQL DDL script defining the `users` table (id, username, password_hash, is_active, created_at) with a unique index on username, usable as a manual bootstrap alternative to the Alembic migration.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker file that makes `backend/tests` importable as a Python package for the backend's pytest test suite.

nodes.name: test_chat.py
nodes.summary: Pytest suite for the chat streaming endpoint, covering a 404 for unknown documents, a 400 for documents still processing, and a successful event-stream response for a fully ingested document.

nodes.name: test_graph.py
nodes.summary: Pytest suite covering RAG helper functions `_build_citations` and `_format_context`, verifying citation deduplication and page-number-prefixed context formatting.

nodes.name: upgrade
nodes.summary: Enables the pgvector extension and defines the initial `documents` and `chunks` tables, including a vector embedding column, as part of the first database migration.

nodes.name: upgrade
nodes.summary: Drops and recreates the `chunks` table to correct the pgvector embedding column's dimensionality.

nodes.name: upgrade
nodes.summary: Creates the parent-chunk table with foreign key and uniqueness constraints, then adds and indexes a `parent_id` column linking existing chunks to their parent context blocks.

nodes.name: upgrade
nodes.summary: Replaces the chunk embedding column with a 1536-dimension pgvector column and backfills data via raw SQL, aligning storage with the truncated embedding model output.

nodes.name: upgrade
nodes.summary: Adds multiple metadata columns (type, counts, JSONB metadata, status fields) to the `documents` table and creates a supporting index.

nodes.name: upgrade
nodes.summary: Creates the `users` table with a UUID primary key, username, password hash, active flag, and created-at timestamp, plus a unique index on username, to support JWT authentication.

nodes.name: upgrade
nodes.summary: Creates the `conversations` and `messages` tables with foreign keys to users/conversations, JSONB message metadata, and indexes, forming the persistence schema for chat history.

nodes.name: test_chat_stream_400_for_processing_document
nodes.summary: Verifies the chat streaming endpoint returns HTTP 400 when the requested document has not finished processing.

nodes.name: test_chat_stream_returns_event_stream_for_done_document
nodes.summary: Verifies the chat streaming endpoint returns a proper server-sent event stream when the target document's status is `done`, mocking the underlying RAG pipeline call.

nodes.name: test_build_citations_includes_page_and_source_and_dedups
nodes.summary: Verifies that `_build_citations` produces deduplicated citation entries including page number and source metadata from mocked chunk objects.
